messages.subject: micro_era5
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've just added a new function 'micro_era5' to NicheMapR. It allows you to run the microclimate model with the powerful new data set ERA5 from the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S). This was made possible by James Duffy's package mcera5. There's an example of how to use it, including the first step of downloading a time/space slice of the ERA5 data with mcera5, in the examples section of the help for this function.

Let me know if you find any issues with it.

All the best,
Mike
